notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is the frame loop's step (none while the chart's animation is paused) and a read of every graphic element.
the frame loop never runs by itself here (no requestAnimationFrame), so it never sleeps and never resets the paused time.

cases.note: custom rects (renderItem gradItem, GRADS by index) whose style.fill goes gradient to gradient under transition ['style']: linear 2 stops to 2 (geometry, offsets, colours with alpha); linear 2 to 3 stops (the from list padded with its last stop); linear 3 to 2 (the target's padded: the interpolated end has three stops); radial to radial with global, on the series' update timing (cubicOut 400); a stroke gradient beside a colour fill; a linear to a radial (discrete: it jumps); a colour to a gradient and a gradient to a colour (discrete); named colours and 'transparent' in the stops

a keyframe animation on style.fill through three linear gradients (a missing 0%: from the current one) with a keyframe's own easing, a loop on a radial one, and a keyframe from a linear gradient to a colour (discrete allowed: it switches at the keyframe)

the chart's animation paused at 300 and resumed at 700: no sample in between moves, after it every clip goes on 400 ms behind; a second pause and a resume while running do nothing; then a merge during a second pause (1300-1600): its flush steps every clip once, at the clock less the paused time so far, and the new clips start there

one element's animator paused at 200 and resumed at 600 while the chart runs: that clip counts each frame's delta as paused time and holds its value; the other element runs on; a loop's animator paused across where it would restart, then resumed (its restart forgets the paused time)

the chart's animation paused at 300; at 500 a merge that changes only the bar series' data: its flush steps the graphic element's entering clip to the clock (500), though the graphic was not in the merge; resumed at 700 the clip goes on 400 ms behind

two stops to three: three stops mid-way
three to two: the end itself has three stops
the end of an interpolation is rgba, not the colour written
a colour to a gradient jumps
a gradient to a colour jumps
a keyframe gradient from the current one (its own two stops: the padding went to the last keyframe)
a keyframe's easing on its segment
a gradient to a colour keyframe switches
